A map of lists. The queue holds four records, two of them with the same ready_at, one with none, and one with a map the others lack. mixed holds one scalar of every kind, numbers holds whole numbers with one repeated, labels holds strs with two repeated, nested holds a list among its elements, long holds a whole number too long for shell arithmetic, and none is empty. sort_by, group_by, min and max run with one path, with two paths, with the path of the element itself and with no path. The calls show the order of the kinds, that elements which tie keep their order, that min answers the first of several and max the last, what the empty list answers, and that a map or a list where a scalar is compared, a document that is not a list, and a path with an open bracket are refused.
